items.quote: The Pylon API uses Bearer authentication.
items.why: States the public API uses Bearer authentication, matching bearer_token.

items.quote: Only Admins can create and manage API tokens.
items.why: Admin-only token creation is consistent with admin-created tokens but does not name Bearer.

items.quote: Your sales representative will work with you on setting up the demo organization.
items.why: Sales-rep demo setup hints at sales-provisioned trials, but does not state a paid or account gate.
Annual contracts relate to the paid-workspace gate but do not establish credential access on their own.

items.quote: Pylon's API can be used to programmatically access and take action on data within Pylon.
items.why: Says the API accesses data generally; no REST, domains, SDKs or breadth stated.

items.quote: The Pylon MCP server at https://mcp.usepylon.com provides AI tools access to your Pylon data.
items.why: Names the Pylon MCP server at mcp.usepylon.com providing AI access to Pylon data; implies vendor-official.

items.quote: The Pylon MCP server only supports OAuth authentication. API key authentication is not currently available.
items.why: Describes MCP auth as OAuth-only; consistent with the server existing, but does not state existence, URL or vendor-official.
